fieldValues.title: Converge the implementation on the spec, one tracked fix per divergence
fieldValues.move: Every divergence between spec, schema and an implementation becomes one issue answering SP-01 in the unattended lane, fixed on the implementation side unless a ruling says the spec is wrong.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: The root causes of drift (multiple definitions, missing CI gates); those need their own remedy.
fieldValues.falsifier: A divergence found by an agent or user that has no issue, or an SP-01 issue left untouched for 30 days in the unattended lane.
fieldValues.return_when: When the unattended lane has run for two weeks, or when a new divergence class appears.
